description: Read a note's content. Brief mode (default) returns title + metadata + linked-note titles; full mode returns full content + edge context. Full mode also reports `truncated: true` when the body exceeded `maxContentLength` (default 2000 chars) and was sliced. Response is wrapped as `{data, context}` where `context.next_actions` suggests follow-ups like creating missing linked notes or exploring outgoing connections.

maxContentLength.description: In `full` mode, max body chars before truncation. Default 2000.

mode.description: Default `"brief"` (metadata + linked-note titles). `"full"` adds the body + edge context.

name.description: Path, filename, or fuzzy match for the note to read.

name: read_note
